references.title: Event page with guest list and registration status
references.question: Q5
references.take: Shows guest list with capacity (cap 1000), pending/invited/attended status, and role-based permissions for attendance.

references.title: Event tickets with capacity limits and availability
references.question: Q5
references.take: Tickets tab shows capacity (0/25 general, 0/20 student), sold status, and option to edit capacity.

references.title: Class schedule with time zone and availability grid
references.question: Q5
references.take: Schedule grid with time zone selector (Asia/Singapore), available time slots per day, book button per slot.

references.title: Mentoring session scheduling with availability and role settings
references.question: Q5
references.take: Availability section shows time zone (GMT-07:00), daily hours, and role-based registration options (audience/producer).

references.title: Event type scheduling settings with capacity and buffer controls
references.question: Q5
references.take: Settings show buffer time (10 min before/after), minimum notice (4 hours), daily limits, time zone (Honolulu), and start time increments.

references.title: Event booking with time zone, duration, and availability settings
references.question: Q5
references.take: Event creation flow shows availability section with recurring meetings, date overrides, buffer before/after session (15 min), and time zone selector.

references.title: Confirming attendance for an event
references.question: Q5
references.take: Two-step flow: event details with attendance status and 'Attend' button, then confirmed attendance state with checkmark.

references.title: Marking session attendance as completed
references.question: Q5
references.take: Host workflow: sessions list with 'mark attendance' prompt, marking sessions complete/no-show, automatic 5-day auto-mark for absent sessions.

references.title: Guest marked as checked in
references.question: Q5
references.take: Three-step guest flow: status change to 'Set Checked In', confirmation, and guestlist with checked-in badge.

references.title: Scheduling with duration presets and time zone

references.take: Availability form with time zone selector (US/Canada), duration options (30/15 min presets), and time grid display.

references.title: Meeting scheduling with time zone and duration picker
references.question: Q6
references.take: Schedule form with time zone dropdown (PST), duration input (45 min), and calendar date picker with available times.

references.title: Schedule meeting with time zone, duration, and recurring options
references.question: Q6
references.take: Meeting form shows time zone selector (GMT-7:00 Pacific), duration with hour/minute inputs, and recurring meeting controls.

references.title: Session scheduling with time zone and duration
references.question: Q6
references.take: Create session modal shows time zone picker (New York), duration indicator (30 minutes), calendar picker, and time slot selector.

references.title: Availability scheduling with time zone and buffer settings
references.question: Q6
references.take: Availability page shows time zone (Asia/Jakarta), weekly hours (9:00-17:00), date overrides, and buffer settings.

references.title: Meeting availability settings with time zone
references.question: Q6
references.take: Availability form shows time zone selector, working hours by day (9:00-5:00pm), and add another availability range option.

references.title: Scheduling a meeting across time zones
references.question: Q6
references.take: Chat flow: proposing meeting date/time picker with multiple time zone support (America/New_York), duration selection.

references.title: Scheduling a meeting with attendees, time zone and duration
references.question: Q6
references.take: Complete meeting creation: attendees list, time/duration fields, time zone selector (GMT+7:00 Jakarta), recurring options.

references.title: Booking a meeting with time zone and duration options
references.question: Q6
references.take: Four-step booking flow: duration preset selection, date/time picker with time zone (Asia/Jakarta), confirmation, and success message.

references.title: RSVP options with max capacity and waitlist (iOS)
references.question: Q5
references.take: iOS RSVP form shows max capacity (25, Waitlist on), plus-ones option, guest approval requirement, and emoji button style customization.

references.title: Event ticket pricing and capacity display (iOS)
references.question: Q5
references.take: iOS event details showing multiple ticket tiers with pricing, capacity status (SOLD OUT badge), sales end date, and registration deadline.

references.title: Task scheduling with time and time zone (iOS)
references.question: Q6
references.take: iOS time picker shows time range (10:28 AM - 11:28 AM), toggle for adding duration, duration input (1 hr), and time zone selector.

references.title: Arrival window and scheduling settings (iOS)
references.question: Q6
references.take: iOS job scheduling with arrival window presets (15/30 min, 1/2/3 hr), arrival window style toggle (before/center), and calendar date picker.
